notes.author: user
notes.text: Before publication, Worktree Switcher must be able to register itself as a service or otherwise guarantee continuous controller operation.

notes.author: agent:codex
notes.text: Foreground operation remains useful for evaluation and diagnostics, but a user-level OS service becomes the recommended daily-use installation. Do not require root or copy host-specific llm-worker resource limits into portable units.

notes.author: agent:codex
notes.text: Implemented the portable service foundation: explicit install/status/start/stop/restart/uninstall plus access URL commands, controlled systemd user and LaunchAgent definitions, refresh detection, controller singleton locking, owner-only pairing metadata, safe service output, graceful owned-process shutdown, and lightweight controller CPU/RSS/uptime reporting. Unit tests cover definitions, idempotency, status parsing, access-file permissions, and lock behavior. Keep this item open until packaged Linux and macOS lifecycle/crash/upgrade validation is completed on real service managers.

notes.author: agent:codex
notes.text: Completed an isolated end-to-end systemd user-service test on llm-worker using separate data/state directories and ports. The first real parser check found and fixed quoting of WorkingDirectory. After rebuilding, systemd-analyze verification, install/enable/start, idempotent reinstall without a PID change, singleton rejection, controlled restart, SIGKILL recovery with restart backoff, status/resource reporting, authenticated endpoint behavior, owner-only runtime files, journal/application-log secret scanning, stop/start, refresh refusal, and idempotent uninstall all passed. Uninstall preserved state and credentials; the test data and service artifact were then removed. macOS LaunchAgent validation remains outstanding.

notes.author: agent:codex
notes.text: Fixed managed project startup when a package manager is installed in a user directory such as ~/.local/bin. Service definitions now add only PATH directories containing a detected supported package manager, alongside Node and standard system directories, rather than inheriting the full interactive PATH. Verified on llm-worker by refreshing the real systemd user service and starting WinPath through the authenticated controller API; pnpm resolved and Next.js reached Ready over HTTPS.

notes.author: agent:codex
notes.text: CI 36312411574 supplies real packaged Linux systemd lifecycle evidence, including isolated session-manager restart, singleton/port-conflict behavior and idempotent removal. Remaining: populated package upgrade and failure recovery (shared with the package trial item), unexpected-controller-failure/owned-child acceptance, and a real macOS LaunchAgent trial. No user service was changed during reconciliation.

problem: Service installation and Linux lifecycle behavior are implemented and historically exercised. Packaged upgrade coverage and real macOS LaunchAgent validation remain outstanding.

risk.rollback: Remove only isolated validation fixtures and restore a changed test service definition. Leave the owner's installed service and state untouched unless that lifecycle change was separately authorized.

scope: Use the portable package smoke work as input, then finish packaged lifecycle/upgrade checks on Linux and macOS without redesigning the service layer.
Recheck owned-child cleanup for deliberate stop and unexpected controller failure after the linked fix. Preserve unknown processes and user data.

Keep absolute service paths generated from each installation and host resource policy external to portable templates. Do not restart or replace the owner's installed service as part of backlog maintenance.
title: Finish packaged service lifecycle validation on supported platforms
validation: Install and enable the service from a packaged executable on supported Linux and macOS environments, log out or close the invoking terminal as appropriate, and verify the controller, dashboard, and MCP remain reachable according to platform session policy.

Verify service install, refresh, status, start, stop, restart, and uninstall are idempotent, require no root privileges, and never delete user state or logs unless a separate destructive command is explicitly confirmed.

Crash the controller and verify the service manager restarts it with bounded backoff, records the reason, leaves no duplicate/orphan managed process tree, and reconciles projects before serving mutations.
Attempt a foreground second instance while the service runs and verify it fails clearly before opening SQLite, binding listeners, or spawning a project.
Verify a deliberate service stop gracefully terminates every owned process tree while never killing an unrelated process merely because it occupies a configured port.
Upgrade the package so its executable path or version changes, refresh the service, and verify status reports the new version while database migrations and credentials remain intact.
Inspect generated units/plists, process arguments, environment, journal output, and application logs and verify no pairing URL, bearer token, password, or resolved secret is persisted there.
value: Worktree Switcher becomes dependable workstation infrastructure instead of a terminal-bound utility, while retaining a reversible user-level installation and correct ownership of every managed server.
